description: Produce a standard-library Python module that rewrites JSON object keys to lower snake_case, plus pytest tests. Choose this when object keys must become lower snake_case, with values left untouched. Do not choose this expecting acronym splitting: a capital run like HTTPServer becomes httpserver, not http_server. Example requests: Write a Python module that rewrites JSON object keys to lower snake_case, with tests. | I need camelCase keys converted to snake_case without changing the values. | Generate a key-normalisation module and a pytest suite.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

module_name.description: Lowercase module name, used for the file name.

template.description: Which registered behaviour to produce. The behaviour is fixed by the template and verified by the template's own tests.
